Found 29 items in registries @wa-ui:

Showing items 1-29 of 29:

- chat-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style message bubble with incoming/outgoing variants, timestamps, read receipts, group chat sender, and animated tail. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chat-list-item (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style conversation list row with color avatar initials, name, last message, timestamp, unread badge, read receipts, mute, and pin. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chat-header (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style conversation header with avatar, contact name, online status, and action buttons. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- message-input (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style message composer with emoji, attachment, auto-resize textarea, and send/voice toggle. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- date-separator (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style centered date pill divider for separating messages by date. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- typing-indicator (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style animated typing indicator with three bouncing dots and optional sender name. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- reaction-pill (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style emoji reaction pill with count and toggle state using @base-ui/react Toggle. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- image-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style image bubble supporting single image, multi-image grid (2x2 with +N overflow), loading skeleton, and captions. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- video-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style video message bubble with play/pause, duration badge, caption, and read receipts. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- voice-message-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style voice message with play/pause, waveform, playback progress, duration, and read receipts. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- file-attachment-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style file bubble with type-based color icon badge, file name/size, download progress via @base-ui/react Progress, and read receipts. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- template-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp Business template message bubble supporting text/image/video/document/location headers and url/phone/quick_reply/copy_code/flow/call_permission buttons. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- carousel-template (registry:component) - WhatsApp Business carousel template with horizontal scrollable cards using @base-ui/react ScrollArea. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- call-permission (registry:component) - WhatsApp Business calling permission request bubble with animated bottom sheet, radio options, and calling rules footer using @base-ui/react Drawer and RadioGroup. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- message-status (registry:component) - Shared MessageStatus type and MessageStatusIcon — sending, sent, delivered, read, failed. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- contact-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style contact card — single or multiple contacts with name, phone, avatar, and action buttons. [@wa-ui]

- sticker-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style sticker message — 160×160px, no bubble background, animated badge support. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- system-message-bubble (registry:component) - Centered system notice pill — encryption notices, number changes, and other system events. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- reply-preview (registry:component) - Quoted message strip shown inside a bubble — author, body preview, media type icon, thumbnail. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- forwarded-label (registry:component) - Small italic label indicating a forwarded or frequently forwarded message. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- unsupported-message-bubble (registry:component) - Fallback bubble for unknown or unsupported WhatsApp message types. [@wa-ui]

- interactive-button-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp interactive button message — up to 3 reply buttons with header/body/footer. [@wa-ui]

- cta-url-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp interactive CTA URL message — single external link button with body/footer. [@wa-ui]

- list-message-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp interactive list message — CTA opens a bottom sheet with selectable sections and rows. [@wa-ui]

- interactive-reply-bubble (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style interactive reply bubble — shows received button, list, or flow replies with icon and subtype label. [@wa-ui]

- reaction (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style emoji reaction display — single reaction with count or overlapping multi-reaction group. [@wa-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- action-button (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style outlined pill action button with optional icon, using @base-ui/react Button. [@wa-ui]

- chat-menu (registry:component) - WhatsApp-style context dropdown menu with icons, links, danger items, using @base-ui/react Menu. [@wa-ui]
